findings.summary: Activating either hero button scrolls to the menu but leaves keyboard focus on the now off-screen button.
findings.fix: Use links to the menu section and move focus to its heading or section after navigation; make the focus target programmatically focusable with tabindex="-1".
findings.evidence: Both buttons call scrollToSection('menu-section'); scrollToSection only calls scrollIntoView.

passed: Hero buttons are native buttons and appear in a logical DOM and visual order at desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints.
Hero buttons have a visible :focus-visible outline.
notes: This keyboard focus issue predates the visual-only CSS update; no hero markup or interaction behavior was changed.
